entries.headline: Munetaka Murakami connected at +232
entries.story: Munetaka Murakami cashed. Facing Jackson Jobe, he went deep in the 4th in his 3rd at bat. The call: "Munetaka Murakami homers (27) on a fly ball to right field." Final line: 1-for-3 with 1 BB.

entries.headline: Eugenio Suárez came close
entries.story: Eugenio Suárez went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Sandy Alcantara and the Miami Marlins. Closest call was a double in the 6th: "Eugenio Suárez doubles (15) on a line drive to center fielder Jakob Marsee. Tyler Stephenson scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.
